description: Use this when a maker wants to list their own app, product or open-source project on AppFinder, or get it discovered. Reads the app's website, merges what the maker told you, and returns a plain preview of the listing plus a private link. Show the maker the preview and anything still missing, then give them the link: they sign in, review every field and submit, and nothing is published until AppFinder's team approves it. Listing is free. Call check_listing first. Pass only what the maker said or what you can see in their repo; leave out what you don't know (the website fills the gaps). Never submit for them.

category.description: Category name or slug from list_categories.

description.description: Who it's for and what they can do with it (at least 20 characters).

logo_url.description: A square logo image over https.

pricing_model.description: free, freemium (free plan + paid plans), paid, open_source or contact_sales.

pricing_summary.description: One line, like “Free plan; paid plans from $8 per user per month.”

starting_price_usd.description: Lowest paid plan per month, in US dollars.

tagline.description: One line that says what it does, without claims like “#1” or “best”.

name: list_my_app
title: List my app on AppFinder
